requirement.description: The _convert_to_int method in Layout class doesn't properly handle complex reset values like dictionaries when constructing signals with reset values. Tests show "Reset value must be a constant-castable expression" errors when passing dictionaries like {'a': 1, 'b': 2}.
requirement.contract: Modify the _convert_to_int method to properly handle Mapping and Sequence values for complex reset initialization. The method should accept dictionaries and sequences representing nested layouts and correctly convert them to integer constants.

requirement.description: The View.__getattr__ method in data.py has incorrect error handling for reserved names and missing attributes. Tests show AttributeError messages don't match expected formats for reserved names and missing fields.
requirement.contract: Update View.__getattr__ to provide more accurate error messages that match expected test outputs. Specifically, reserved names should trigger a specific error message indicating they must be accessed via indexing, and missing fields should show available field names in the error message.

requirement.description: Error message formatting in enum validation is inconsistent. Tests show mismatched error message patterns for enum validation errors, particularly for shape validation.
requirement.contract: Standardize error message formats in EnumMeta class to match expected test patterns. Specifically, adjust error messages for shape mismatches and value casting to match the expected format patterns.
